sentences.en: There's nothing better than a hearty bowl of lentil soup!
sentences.zh: 没有什么比一碗美味的扁豆汤更好的了！

sentences.en: He sold his inheritance for a plate of lentil soup.
sentences.zh: 他用一份扁豆汤卖掉了他的遗产。

sentences.en: Lentils are among the best sources of plant proteins.
sentences.zh: 扁豆是植物蛋白的最佳来源之一。

senses.zh: [作物] 兵豆，[作物] 小扁豆
